content: Emetrol is an over-the-counter medication used to alleviate nausea and vomiting. It is classified as an antiemetic and is formulated as a syrup. The active ingredients in each 5 mL dose include 1.87 grams of glucose, 1.87 grams of fructose, and 21.5 milligrams of phosphoric acid. The inactive components of the formulation are FD&C Red No. 40, flavoring agents, glycerin, methylparaben, and purified water. Due to the presence of fructose in its composition, Emetrol is contraindicated in individuals with hereditary fructose intolerance (HFI). Patients with diabetes are advised to consult their healthcare provider prior to using this medication, as it contains sugars that may affect blood glucose levels. The medication should not be used for more than one hour, which corresponds to a maximum of five doses, without seeking medical advice. If symptoms of an upset stomach persist or occur frequently, it is essential to consult a physician.
